# XOLNET Technologies Private Limited

> XOLNET Technologies Private Limited (also written Xolnet or XOLNET) is an Indian company based in Sambalpur, Odisha. It runs a digital marketing agency, an IT products and accessories store, and an IT training academy (XOLNET Academy). Official website: https://www.xolnet.in. The name is spelled X-O-L-N-E-T.
